'''Jorus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who was a flight [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Jorus was [[Death/Legends|killed]] while fighting near the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
